versions.changelog:
Audience Sentiment & Intent Analyzer 1.0.0

- Initial release of a multi-platform AI skill for analyzing audience sentiment, intent, and emerging trends across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and email.
- Automatically extracts buying intent, pain points, feature requests, churn signals, and persona shifts from comments, DMs, and replies.
- Provides structured JSON reports with actionable insights, content gap analysis, and recommendations.
- Supports integration with major social APIs, Gmail, Slack, and manual CSV/JSON data imports.
- Features configurable sentiment velocity analysis, topic extraction, early warning alerts, and audience persona evolution.
